items.title: Eric Alexander interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: It’s like Joe DiMaggio’s signature or something.

ctx.x: And was that because of your compatriots in Indiana?

That I mentioned George Coleman? You know I swear I really don’t know why. I think maybe in a DownBeat magazine. You know of course I had heard him on a recording. I used to listen to “Maiden Voyage” so he is one of the tenor players that I knew of. But I remember there was an ad in DownBeat magazine for these plastic reeds, which I don’t think he ever used, but he was one of the endorsers. I and just remember his signature. His signature is very clean, like the way he plays. You know he doesn’t make a big hoop…
That’s neat how that stuff happens.
